WHERE L.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND (L.LAW_FIRM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR L.LAWYER_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM RN, A.* FROM ( SELECT L.LAWYER_ID AS lawyerId, L.LAW_FIRM AS lawFirm, L.LAWYER_NM AS lawyerNm, L.EMAIL AS email, L.TEL AS tel, L.MOBILE AS mobile, SUBSTR(L.REG_DT, 1, 8) AS regDt, NVL(AG.CNT, 0) AS assignCnt, ST.AVG_SCORE AS satisAvg, NVL(ST.CNT, 0) AS satisCnt FROM LAW_LAWYER L LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT SL.LAWYER_ID, COUNT(*) CNT FROM LAW_SUIT_LAWYER SL GROUP BY SL.LAWYER_ID ) AG ON AG.LAWYER_ID = L.LAWYER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT SL.LAWYER_ID, ROUND(AVG(SA.SCORE), 1) AVG_SCORE, COUNT(*) CNT FROM LAW_LAWYER_SATIS SA JOIN LAW_SUIT_LAWYER SL ON SL.ASSIGN_ID = SA.ASSIGN_ID GROUP BY SL.LAWYER_ID ) ST ON ST.LAWYER_ID = L.LAWYER_ID
ORDER BY L.LAWYER_ID DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{lastIndex} ) WHERE RN > #{firstIndex}
SELECT LAWYER_ID AS lawyerId, LAW_FIRM AS lawFirm, LAWYER_NM AS lawyerNm, EMAIL AS email, TEL AS tel, MOBILE AS mobile, DEL_YN AS delYn FROM LAW_LAWYER WHERE LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE LAW_LAWYER SET LAW_FIRM = #{lawFirm}, LAWYER_NM = #{lawyerNm}, EMAIL = #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEL = #{tel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MOBILE = #{mobile, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPD_USER_ID = #{updUserId}, UPD_DT = #{updDt} WHERE LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId}
